```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
var __commonJS = (factory, flags, id, isEntry, module) => function __require() {
	if (module !== undefined) {
		return module.exports;
	}
	module = { exports: {} };
	if (isEntry) module.isEntry = true;
	if (flags & 1) module.id = id;
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = false;
	if (flags & 4) factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports, undefined);
	else factory(module, module.exports, undefined);
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = true;
	return module.exports;
};
var require_foo = /*#__PURE__*/ __commonJS(function(module, exports) {

/*!*****************!*\
  !*** ./foo.cjs ***!
  \*****************/
/* module decorator */ module = __webpack_require__.nmd(module);
function defExports(m) {
  m.exports = 42
}

defExports(module)
}, 0, "./foo.cjs");

// ./index.js
// import default from cjs
// js/esm: the default is module.exports of cjs
// js/auto: check __esModule in runtime
//        if so, module.exports.default, otherwise module.exports
//        otherwise, module.exports


it('should have correct interop for cjs', async () => {
  const { value } = await import(/*webpackIgnore: true*/ './main.mjs')
  expect(value).toBe(42)
})
const foo_0 = require_foo();

export { foo_0 as value };

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/node_module_decorator
(() => {
__webpack_require__.nmd = (module) => {
  module.paths = [];
  if (!module.children) module.children = [];
  return module;
};
})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
